label: A more sovereign architecture
text:
A more sovereign architecture

By default, CARLOS apps are broken down into full-stack deployable instances that run as single processes with embedded databases that can run independently or as part of a SaaS like app deployment. This introduces huge flexibility and portability gains without compromising user experiences.

Before CARLOSWith CARLOSBenefits
Monolithic multi-tenant appsSingle-process per tenantMuch more flexibility
Centralised multi-tenant databasesDatabase per-tenantMore secure, more control
Nightly backupsContinuous streamingRobust data-storage
Single-deployment per appFlexible deployment per tenantEasily deploy multi-platform, multi-region, or self-hosted
Everyone updates at onceTenants can choose whether to upgradeCustomers have more control

section: Better, faster, more productive development cycle
label: Better, faster, more productive development cycle
text:
Better, faster, more productive development

Unlocking the promise of 100x productivity requires a mindset shift: what if everyone on a team can build features, as close to production as possible?

Before CARLOSWith CARLOSBenefits
Complicated development environmentsSimple dev env with few dependenciesLittle to no dev/prod disparity
Prototype -> Plan -> ImplementPrototype and implement in the same stepProgrammers and non-programmers alike move quicker
Slow, clunky dev tools and CIFast compile, fast runtime, fast CIRobust well-tested code with more reliable tests
Slow, brittle preview environmentsInstant full-stack preview environmentsTest multiple versions of features side-by-side
Clunky wrapped web apps for nativeProperly rapidly-built native UI appsShared modules and database schema

Improved operations

By simplifying the architecture, but without compromising on robustness or security, CARLOS apps gain a host of operational benefits.

Before CARLOSWith CARLOSBenefits
A stack of expensive toolsMuch more development and runtime efficiencyMuch higher cost:performance ratio
Prototype -> Plan -> ImplementPrototype and implement in the same stepProgrammers and non-programmers alike move quicker
Slow, clunky dev tools and CIFast compile, fast runtime, fast CIRobust well-tested code with more reliable tests
Complex container orchestrationLean process orchestrationLightweight operations that are far more efficient

label: More secure defaults
text:
A solid security foundation

Starting from tenant isolation, and going all the way to full end-to-end-encryption if you need.

Before CARLOSWith CARLOSBenefits
Mixing customer dataIsolating customer dataMuch narrower blast radius
Scoped database queriesNo risk of query leakageGreater portability e.g. true SQL access to data
Plaintext almost everywhereEncryption encouragedSecurity at rest, on disk and in transit
Opaque security posture and complianceDeclarative trust classesMore transparency about application security
Third-party security scanningContinuous security scanning baked inEncouraging good security hygiene out of the box

label: Tools you can use
text:
Tools you can use

Rastrillo is a web application framework. CARLOS platform handles deployment. Carloku is the hosted option. You can also run CARLOS yourself.
